content: सन्न {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [सद्-क्त] .²1 Sitting down, settling down, lying. .²2 Dejected, sunk down, downcast. .²3 Drooping, relaxed; नालक्षयत् साध्वससन्नहस्तः <ls>Ku. 3. 51</ls>. .²4 Weak, low, feeble. .²5 Wasted away, decayed. .²6 Perished, destroyed. .²7 Still, motionless. .²8 Shrunk. .²9 Adjacent, near. .²10 Gone, departed. .²11 Sunk, low (in tone <ab>&c.</ab>). .{@-न्नः@} The tree called पियाल. .{@-न्नम्@} .²1 A little, a small quantity. .²2 Destruction, loss.

संनम् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To bend, stoop, incline; संनताङ्गी <ls>Ku. 1. 34</ls>; <ls>Bk. 2. 31</ls>; पर्वसु संनता <ls>V. 4. 26</ls>. .²2 To submit or subject oneself to, obey; संनमतामरीणाम् <ls>R. 18. 34</ls>. .²3 To bend down, bow down to. .²4 To make ready, prepare. .²5 To be accomplished. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To contract, bend together. .²2 To cause to bend or stoop. .²3 To make ready, prepare.
